tiers.notes: All features, including virtual camera, telephony relay and multi-window, are exercised in CI device farms. Android 13+ recommended.
Aggressive background restrictions must be lifted for the companion service. See the OEM matrix below.
Mirroring and input work; telephony and call features are unavailable on tablets/TV.

oem.restriction: Battery optimization and 'Put unused apps to sleep' can stop the companion service.
oem.fix: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Android DEX Companion. Disable 'Pause USB power delivery' for sustained mirroring.

oem.restriction: Autostart is blocked by default; USB debugging (Security settings) is required for input injection.
oem.fix: Enable Developer options → USB debugging (Security settings), turn on Autostart, set battery saver to 'No restrictions'.

oem.restriction: Adaptive battery and 'Sleep standby optimization' kill foreground services.
oem.fix: Battery → More settings → Sleep standby optimization off; allow background activity for the companion.

oem.restriction: High background power consumption prompts appear after 3 minutes.
oem.fix: i Manager → App Manager → Autostart → allow companion; set battery to unrestricted.

oem.restriction: No Google Mobile Services: RCS and some system integrations are unavailable.
oem.fix: SMS/MMS and mirroring work; use the local plugin catalog instead of GMS-dependent features.

requiredSettings: Developer options → Disable permission monitoring (needed on some OEMs for input injection)
Companion app: notification access, call/SMS permissions, microphone, camera

knownIssues.symptom: Device shows as 'unauthorized' or 'offline' on Windows
knownIssues.workaround: Install the OEM USB driver or WinUSB via Zadig, then `adb kill-server && android-dex reconnect`.

knownIssues.symptom: Black window or no input on Apple Silicon
knownIssues.workaround: Grant Screen Recording + Accessibility to Android DEX in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then restart the app.

knownIssues.symptom: Protocol mismatch / server fails to start
knownIssues.workaround: Use the bundled scrcpy; override with DEX_SCRCPY_PATH only when the device requires a newer build. Check `android-dex doctor`.
Pin the 5 GHz band, disable AP roaming/band steering for the phone, or switch the transport preference to USB.
